title: Design System: Build plan for CPFB app builders

display.purpose: Page title in PageHeader. One per page.

heading.purpose: Page sections in SectionHeading, the floor plan heading, the title-block lettering.

title.purpose: Panel and Dialog titles, drawn by the component from a plain string.

lead.purpose: Sub-sections inside panels and dialogs, note titles, room names, sheet tabs, page description.

body.purpose: Running text, rows, fields, md buttons. Stops at 72ch.

small.purpose: Hints, stamps, tags, table headers, segmented choices, sm buttons, code.

label.purpose: Title-block cell labels only. Uppercase, 0.12em tracking.

code.purpose: Commands and the agent snippet, at the small step.

shadows.name: dock
shadows.purpose: The editor's sticky save dock over scrolling rows only.

motion.name: room-area
motion.purpose: Floor plan areas grow and shrink in place when counts change. Off under reduced motion.

widths.name: page
widths.purpose: A page that is one form.

widths.name: measure
widths.purpose: The longest line of running text.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Solid blueprint. The one main action on a screen.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn ds-btn-primary">Build plan for your agent</button>
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 2px; font: 600 16px/1.5 'Barlow Semi Condensed', Barlow, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.01em; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s, border-color 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--color-blueprint, #1d4e89); color: var(--color-paper, #fff); border: 0; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-blueprint-deep, #163c6b); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-blueprint, #1d4e89); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Ruled paper button for every other action.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 2px; font: 600 16px/1.5 'Barlow Semi Condensed', Barlow, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.01em; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s, border-color 0.15s; } .ds-btn-secondary { background: var(--color-paper, #fff); color: var(--color-ink, #0f2a4a); border: 1px solid var(--color-rule-strong, #6f89ad); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--color-blueprint, #1d4e89); background: var(--color-blueprint-wash, #e7eef8); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-blueprint, #1d4e89); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Quiet Button
components.description: Text button in blueprint for minor actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-quiet { height: 32px; background: none; border: 0; padding: 0; color: var(--color-blueprint, #1d4e89); font: 600 14px/1.45 'Barlow Semi Condensed', Barlow, system-ui, sans-serif; text-underline-offset: 4px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-quiet:hover { text-decoration: underline; } .ds-btn-quiet:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-blueprint, #1d4e89); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Field
components.description: Labelled control with hint; every form field goes through it.
components.html: Shown in the title block.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; } .ds-field-label { font: 600 16px/1.5 'Barlow Semi Condensed', Barlow, system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--color-ink, #0f2a4a); } .ds-field-hint { margin: 0; font: 400 14px/1.45 Barlow, system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--color-ink-soft, #4a6280); } .ds-input { height: 40px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--color-rule-strong, #6f89ad); border-radius: 2px; background: var(--color-paper, #fff); color: var(--color-ink, #0f2a4a); font: 400 16px Barlow, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-input:hover, .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--color-blueprint, #1d4e89); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-blueprint, #1d4e89); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Title Block
components.description: The page header: blueprint band of ruled cells with lettered labels and the sheet tabs.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-tb { display: flex; background: var(--color-blueprint, #1d4e89); color: var(--color-paper, #fff); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-ink, #0f2a4a); font-family: Barlow, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-tb-cell { display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: space-between; gap: 6px; padding: 12px 20px; } .ds-tb-cell + .ds-tb-cell { border-left: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.25); } .ds-tb-grow { flex: 1; } .ds-tb-label { font: 600 11px/1.3 'Barlow Semi Condensed', Barlow, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.7); } .ds-tb-name { font: 700 26px/1 'Barlow Semi Condensed', Barlow, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-tb-tabs { display: flex; gap: 24px; } .ds-tb-tabs a { font: 600 18px/1.35 'Barlow Semi Condensed', Barlow, sans-serif; color: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.8); text-decoration: none; text-underline-offset: 6px; } .ds-tb-tabs a:hover { color: #fff; text-decoration: underline; } .ds-tb-tabs a[aria-current=page] { color: #fff; text-decoration: underline 2px; } .ds-tb-tabs a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ruled Panel
components.description: White paper, one 1px rule, 2px corners, ruled title strip. No shadow.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-panel { background: var(--color-paper, #fff); border: 1px solid var(--color-rule, #c3d1e2); border-radius: 2px; color: var(--color-ink, #0f2a4a); font: 400 16px/1.5 Barlow, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-panel-head { padding: 12px 20px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-rule, #c3d1e2); } .ds-panel-head h2 { margin: 0; font: 600 22px/1.25 'Barlow Semi Condensed', Barlow, sans-serif; } .ds-panel-head p { margin: 2px 0 0; font-size: 14px; color: var(--color-ink-soft, #4a6280); } .ds-panel-body { padding: 16px 20px; }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: Ruled strip of choices; the chosen cell is washed and underlined in blueprint.
components.css: .ds-seg { display: inline-flex; border: 1px solid var(--color-rule-strong, #6f89ad); border-radius: 2px; background: var(--color-paper, #fff); } .ds-seg button { height: 36px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; background: none; font: 600 14px 'Barlow Semi Condensed', Barlow, sans-serif; color: var(--color-ink-soft, #4a6280); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s; } .ds-seg button + button { border-left: 1px solid var(--color-rule-strong, #6f89ad); } .ds-seg button:hover { background: rgb(231 238 248 / 0.5); color: var(--color-ink, #0f2a4a); } .ds-seg button[aria-pressed=true] { background: var(--color-blueprint-wash, #e7eef8); color: var(--color-ink, #0f2a4a); border-bottom-color: var(--color-blueprint, #1d4e89); } .ds-seg button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-blueprint, #1d4e89); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Stamps
components.description: Double-ruled drawing stamps for exceptions: pending (redline), published (ink), sample (dotted).
components.html: Not yet verified Published by GovTech Sample
components.css: .ds-stamp { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 1px 6px; border: 1px solid; border-radius: 2px; outline: 1px solid; outline-offset: 1px; background: var(--color-paper, #fff); font: 600 14px/20px 'Barlow Semi Condensed', Barlow, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; margin-right: 8px; } .ds-stamp-pending { color: var(--color-redline, #b8322a); border-color: var(--color-redline, #b8322a); outline-color: var(--color-redline, #b8322a); } .ds-stamp-published { color: var(--color-ink, #0f2a4a); border-color: var(--color-ink, #0f2a4a); outline-color: var(--color-ink, #0f2a4a); } .ds-stamp-sample { color: var(--color-ink-soft, #4a6280); border-color: var(--color-ink-soft, #4a6280); border-style: dotted; outline-color: transparent; }

components.name: Floor Plan Room
components.description: One requirement family as a room: floor areas by count (hatch built, dashed yours, cloud question) with a ruled name plate.
components.css: .ds-plan { display: flex; border: 2px solid var(--color-ink, #0f2a4a); background: var(--color-paper, #fff); } .ds-room { position: relative; flex-basis: 0; min-height: 132px; min-width: 112px; padding: 12px; border: 0; background: none; text-align: left; display: flex; align-items: flex-start; cursor: pointer; } .ds-room + .ds-room { border-left: 1px solid var(--color-ink, #0f2a4a); } .ds-room[aria-pressed=true] { background: var(--color-blueprint-wash, #e7eef8); } .ds-room:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-blueprint, #1d4e89); outline-offset: -4px; } .ds-floor { position: absolute; inset: 8px 5px 8px 8px; display: flex; gap: 3px; } .ds-floor > span { flex-basis: 0; } .ds-built { background: var(--color-blueprint-wash, #e7eef8) repeating-linear-gradient(45deg, rgb(29 78 137 / 0.45) 0 1px, transparent 1px 7px); } .ds-todo { border: 1px dashed var(--color-blueprint, #1d4e89); } .ds-plate { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; padding: 6px 10px; border: 1px solid var(--color-ink, #0f2a4a); background: var(--color-paper, #fff); color: var(--color-ink, #0f2a4a); transition: color 0.15s, border-color 0.15s; } .ds-plate b { font: 600 18px/1.25 'Barlow Semi Condensed', Barlow, sans-serif; } .ds-plate small { font: 400 14px Barlow, sans-serif; color: var(--color-ink-soft, #4a6280); } .ds-room:hover .ds-plate { border-color: var(--color-blueprint, #1d4e89); color: var(--color-blueprint, #1d4e89); } .ds-room[aria-pressed=true] .ds-plate { background: var(--color-blueprint, #1d4e89); border-color: var(--color-blueprint, #1d4e89); color: #fff; } .ds-room[aria-pressed=true] .ds-plate small { color: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.85); }

narrative.overview:
Every page is one sheet of an architect's drawing set. The sheet has a double ruled frame. A blueprint blue title block runs across the top. Below it is white paper with a faint blue grid. The sheet sits on a pale blue-grey drafting table.

The plan is drawn as a building. Each requirement family is a room. Drawing conventions carry the meaning: hatch is built by your tools, solid blue is done, cross-hatch is in progress, a dashed outline is to do, a dotted outline does not apply, and a red revision cloud is an open question. Lines are thin and ruled. Corners are square. Nothing floats except dialogs and the editor's save dock.

The system is small on purpose. There is one token set, one kit of shared components in `app/ui/`, and seven type steps. A new screen uses these and nothing else. The app is for desktop only.
keyCharacteristics: White grid paper, navy ink, 1px ruled lines, 2px corners.
Blueprint blue is rare: the title block, built and done areas, approval stamps, the one primary action.
Redline appears only where something needs attention.
Seven type steps. Uppercase lettering only in the title block.
Lists are ruled schedules, not stacks of cards.

rules.name: The Blueprint Budget Rule
rules.body: Blueprint blue fills only the title block, built and done areas, approval stamps and the one primary action. Everything else is ink on paper.

rules.name: The Redline Rule
rules.body: Redline means "needs attention". Never use it for decoration, emphasis or brand.

rules.name: The Seven Steps Rule
rules.body: Use only text-label, text-small, text-body, text-lead, text-title, text-heading and text-display. Never write a pixel font size.

rules.name: The Title Block Lettering Rule
rules.body: Uppercase lettering and the label step appear only in title-block cells. No uppercase labels, small caps or kickers anywhere else.

rules.name: The Heading Ladder Rule
rules.body: Page title is PageHeader (display). Page sections are SectionHeading (heading). Panel and Dialog titles are plain strings that the component draws at the title step. Sub-sections inside panels and dialogs use lead.

rules.name: The One Schedule Rule
rules.body: A list of items is one ruled box with 1px rules between rows. Never a stack of separate cards.

rules.name: The Width By Role Rule
rules.body: Choose the width by what the content is (work surface, single-form page, editor form, message, running text), never by eye.

rules.name: The Ruled Not Shadowed Rule
rules.body: A panel gets a 1px rule. A shadow means the layer floats: a dialog or the save dock, and nothing else.

dos: Do build every screen from the kit in app/ui/ and the tokens in app/globals.css.
Do use only the seven type steps.
Do use PageHeader for the page title, SectionHeading for page sections, and plain-string titles for Panel and Dialog. Use lead for sub-sections inside them.
Do keep one primary action visible at a time. Use secondary (ruled paper) and quiet (text) for the rest.
Do use the Segmented control for every choice strip.
Do put lists in one ruled box with 1px rules between rows.
Do pick widths by role: full sheet, max-w-page, max-w-form, max-w-message, max-w-measure.
Do use stamps for exceptions only: not yet verified, published by GovTech, sample. Show "Verified" in the tool picker and the detail dialog.
Do use one name per requirement family, from roomName, on every screen.
Do use tabular figures (tnum) for counts and dates.
donts: Don't write pixel font sizes, or use text-label or uppercase outside title-block cells.
Don't use blueprint blue for decoration, or redline for anything that does not need attention.
Don't add shadows to panels, tables or the floor plan.
Don't stack separate cards for a list.
Don't repeat a "Verified" stamp on every list item.
Don't show two solid primary buttons at the same time.
Don't write IM8, SSP, OSCAL, control(s) or agency in our own copy on builder screens. Quoted official wording in the detail dialog is allowed.
Don't round corners past 2px or use pill shapes.
